values: Staff Notes contain any LEAVE- reference code

body.content: {"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080010.000010\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_10\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nFleet update: Vehicle F-207 in for service today. Using F-210 as backup."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080008.000008\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_08\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nElevator B back in service after maintenance. Thanks to the ElevatorPlus team for the quick turnaround."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080016.000016\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_16\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nPest control visit scheduled for Thursday evening after business hours."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080006.000006\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_06\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nNew vendor onboarded: GreenField Environmental. Insurance certs verified."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080018.000018\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_18\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nForklift F-04 battery replacement done. Back in service."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080023.000023\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_23\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nCompressed gas cylinder audit completed. All tags current."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080025.000025\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_25\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nEmergency lighting test completed for all buildings. 2 bulbs replaced in Building D stairwell."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080019.000019\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_19\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nConference room 301 AV equipment upgraded. New wireless casting system is live."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080001.000001\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_01\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nGood morning ops team. Facilities checklist for today is posted in #facilities-daily."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080004.000004\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_04\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nGenerator test completed ✅ All 3 units passed. Logs uploaded to CMMS."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080020.000020\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_20\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nVendor scorecard review meeting at 3 PM. Please review the Q1 reports beforehand."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080014.000014\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_14\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nHVAC filter replacement complete for Building A. Next round: Building C on March 10."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080021.000021\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_21\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nOOO: I'm out Thursday/Friday. Nina is covering warehouse ops."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080003.000003\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_03\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nReminder: fire drill at 2 PM today. Please make sure all exits are clear."}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080015.000015\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_15\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nWeekly ops metrics: Work orders closed: 47. Average resolution time: 6.2 hours. Great work everyone!"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080017.000017\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_17\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nThe roof leak in Building C has been patched. Monitoring for 48 hours before closing the ticket."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080007.000007\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_07\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nPSA: Server room B2 maintenance window Saturday 2-6 AM. UPS bypass test included."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080005.000005\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_05\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nAnyone know if the badge printer in reception is fixed? Still showing paper jam."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080012.000012\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_12\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nParking lot B re-striping scheduled for this weekend. Please park in Lot C."}
{"text": "原始消息元数据：{\"ts\": \"1741080024.000024\", \"user_id\": \"U_ops_24\", \"channel_id\": \"COPS\"}\nThe recycling compactor is jammed again. Maintenance ticket submitted."}
